sources.decision: Record ctime with mtime/size; hash suspects and retain failed/unavailable input. Stat observations do not prove atomic filesystem snapshots.
Create one Program per bounded changed-file batch, extract selected files, retain no Program across refreshes. Snapshot source identities before constructing it.
Keep graph persistence transaction and rollback; propagate failure before hash publication. No power-loss or full installed crash claim from an injected COMMIT failure.
Investigate bounded heap slot reuse. Reject candidate after exact-output paired timings show no convincing ordered-input win and regressions. Retain previous implementation; no upstream code copied.
